title: Glowing lightning bolt
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50' cy='50' r='50' gradientUnits='userSpaceOnUse'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='40%' stop-color='#FFE94D' stop-opacity='0.25'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFD700' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='bolt' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFF9A0'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#FFE833'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB800'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='boltEdge' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFFFF'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFF2A0'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- soft glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>

  <!-- outer glow bolt -->
  <polygon points='58,6 28,48 44,48 50,52 58,48 32,94 72,44 56,44 50,40 42,44'
           fill='#FFD700' opacity='0.45'/>

  <!-- main bolt body -->
  <polygon points='56,10 30,46 45,46 48,49 54,46 34,90 68,42 54,42 51,39 44,42'
           fill='url(#bolt)' stroke='#FFF5B0' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linejoin='round'/>

  <!-- bright core for glow effect -->
  <polygon points='52,20 36,44 46,44 48,46 52,44 40,82 62,44 52,44 50,42 46,44'
           fill='url(#boltEdge)' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- highlight streak -->
  <polygon points='48,18 38,42 44,42 45,44 48,42 42,74 56,42 49,42 48,40 45,42'
           fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- small sparkles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='30' r='2.2' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='78' cy='62' r='2.8' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='24' r='1.8' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='72' r='2' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='78' r='1.5' fill='#FFF9C4' opacity='0.75'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='20' r='1.5' fill='#FFFFFF' opacity='0.65'/>
</svg>
